mostWorthwhile.text: Following the cold clouds through the hot flow to their return was most worthwhile: it showed how different parts of the disturbed gas can have different fates.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final trip to the outer reaches was a fairly predictable next step, though it resolved the clouds' fate.

surprise.text: The dense cloud interiors remained cold while being carried by the hot flow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each followed the physical situation described.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow more of the linked matter histories, especially where encounters lead to different outcomes.
